verdict.rationale: Sardine is a SaaS fraud and compliance platform that holds customer data, so a full data export in open formats is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents bulk export, open-format downloads, or offboarding and data portability. The APIs, webhooks, and dashboards cited concern verification and monitoring workflows, not exporting your data to leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
